content:
claire(auditor): Quick ask: can you produce a compact evidence bundle showing RBAC change workflow mapped to SOC2/ISO controls and KMS rotation/unwrap events for the last 24 months? Need redaction plan and ETA.

sam(sec): Yes. Scope: control-mapping (one-pager), RBAC PR list + approver history, rolebinding diffs, CI snippet that runs `kubectl auth can-i`, KMS metadata (no key material), and a GPG-signed attestation for any manual unwraps. ETA 48h.

hiro(infra): I'll export CloudTrail/Splunk slices. Example Splunk query I'll run: `index=cloudtrail eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=ReEncrypt*) | table _time userIdentity.arn eventName requestParameters` . We'll replace ARNs with tokens like `user:10023` in the bundle and include `redaction-map.csv`.

ana(eng): For RBAC proof I will add PR links and a CI job excerpt. CI snippet: `kubectl apply -f ci/role-test.yaml --dry-run=server` then `kubectl auth can-i create pods --as=system:serviceaccount:team:deploy:ci`. Also include `git diff --staged -- cluster/rolebindings/*.yaml` sample.

claire(auditor): Good. Also include key policy snapshots (CreateDate, RotationStatus, LastUsed) and any manual unwrap events with approver identity. Redaction mapping under NDA is fine. We need human attestation for manual access and the ticket id.

sam(sec): I'll draft the attestation referencing ticket SEC-2026-777 and sign it with GPG. Note: no plaintext keys in bundle.

hiro(infra): Packaging plan: `evidence-2795555555.tar.gz` in s3://audit-evidence/2795555555/ with `manifest.txt` of SHA256s and `index.csv` mapping artifacts to control IDs. I'll post a presigned link when upload completes.

evidence-bot: evidence: prepackage checksums generated (run id: ev-2795555555-01). Expected files: control-map.md, rbac-prs.csv, role-diffs/, kms-events.json.gz, attestations/attestation-signed.txt, redaction-map.csv.

ana(eng): I'll collect PRs touching rolebindings for last 18 months and add a screenshot of required reviewers (redacted).

claire(auditor): ETA 48h is fine. Please drop presigned URL here when ready and we'll begin review. Thanks. :thumbsup:

sam(sec): Thanks team 99I'll review the manifest before upload and sign the attestation. Ping if anything blocks.
